name: NURS 2176
title: Global Politics of Child Health and Development
description: The intersection of global politics, child health, and development within the context of nursing practice; the multifaceted factors influencing child health outcomes worldwide, including political, social, economic, and environmental determinants; and global health policies, initiatives, and interventions aimed at improving child health and development outcomes across diverse cultural and geopolitical contexts. Emphasis is placed on understanding the impact of global differences, health inequities, and social determinants of health on child well-being, as well as the role of nurses as advocates for child health equity and social justice on a global scale.
requirement_description: No requirements to take this course.
